races.race_name: Tote Guarantee Never Beaten By SP Claiming Race

runners.name: Kashel Spring
runners.spotlight: C&D winner for Joseph O'Brien; no impact over hurdles for this yard; modest effort in 1m4f handicap at Tramore on return from 98 days off latest; cheekpieces go on and drops into claiming company for yard with good record in these races.
runners.comment: C&D winner, first run in claimer for yard that does well in these races, cheekpieces on

runners.name: Battling Siki
runners.spotlight: Maiden has shown promise in a couple of his runs; not beaten that far when a 5.25l third in 1m4f Tramore claimer latest in first-time cheekpieces (retained); rated 69, so best treated by race conditions and this drop in trip should suit; can't discount.
runners.comment: Maiden, rated 69, best treated by race conditions, drop in trip a plus, can't discount

runners.name: Concert Party
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Britain with cut in the ground; after a spell over hurdles, didn't show much on return to the Flat at Killarney; a bit to prove for now and might prefer softer conditions.
runners.comment: Poor run on return to the Flat latest, a bit to prove, might prefer it softer

runners.name: She's Ideal
runners.spotlight: 0-12 on turf on the Flat; ran respectably in a couple of handicaps earlier this season, but last three runs haven't been great; could do better now dropped into claiming company, but needs to leave behind recent form.
runners.comment: 0-12 on turf, last three runs not her best, drops in grade, must leave recent form behind

runners.name: Shelbourne Flyer
runners.spotlight: Well backed both starts for this stable; kept on well over 7f at Limerick for a never-dangerous sixth; had an excuse (coughing) when soundly beaten at Leopardstown latest (1m1f, god); tongue-tie (worn on best runs for former yard) returns and also sports blinkers; interesting.
runners.comment: Not a bad run on debut for this yard, excuse for latest, new headgear combo, interesting

runners.name: Minaun View
runners.spotlight: In-form filly arrives in search of a hat-trick after knuckling down to win claimers at Bellewstown (1m, good) and Killarney (1m, good); this longer trip is a query, but should be on the premises again if she stays (stamina in pedigree but ran poorly over 10.5f before).
runners.comment: Back to back 1m claimer wins at Bellewstown & Killarney, big chance if stays this trip

runners.name: Jr Mahon
runners.spotlight: Close third at Limerick in June 2025 beginning to look like a flash in the pan; poor form over hurdles and on the Flat this year; tailed off at Fairyhouse latest (1m6f, good).
runners.comment: Poor form over hurdles and on the Flat this year, tailed off at Fairyhouse latest

runners.name: Romantic War
runners.spotlight: Minor promise in a couple of 7f/1m handicaps last October on soft/heavy off basement mark; toiling this season, however, and impossible to fancy on recent showings.
runners.comment: Best form on soft/heavy, toiling this season, impossible to fancy on recent form

runners.name: Talking Tough
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run and no sign of it ending in recent starts; tailed off at Bellewstown latest and rated just 34 now; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: On long losing run, rated just 34, tailed off at Bellewstown latest, hard to fancy

races.race_name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Maiden

runners.name: Taj Crown
runners.spotlight: Second to a subsequent winner in 1m4f optional claimer at Limerick last month; predictably outclassed by 92-rated foe, who was 1-5, at Killarney last week, but handicapper gave her a 3lb rise all the same; step up in trip will suit.
runners.comment: Form of his second in a 1m4f Limerick maiden last month reads well in the context of this

runners.name: Tyraxes
runners.spotlight: Two decent efforts in ordinary maidens over 1m2f and 1m4f at Dundalk; steps back up in trip after an ordinary effort in an ordinary Killarney maiden last week; should fare better here.
runners.comment: Steps back up in trip after an ordinary effort at Killarney last week; should fare better

runners.name: Guinelot
runners.spotlight: Not a bad level of form in two maiden outings; might have finished closer but for shipping a bump in a 1m3f maiden at Killarney last week; looks the stable second string here, though.
runners.comment: Okay run over further at Killarney last week; looks the stable second string here though

runners.name: Contrite
runners.spotlight: Some encouraging word for her before her debut at Dundalk in November and ran with a deal of credit behind a Listed-class winner; reportedly failed to handle the softer ground at Cork in May; tongue-tie tried here and probably still some upside to this filly; has an ideal opportunity here.
runners.comment: Tongue-tie tried and probably still some upside to this filly; has an ideal opportunity

runners.name: Countertop
runners.spotlight: Poor performer on all known form; step up in trip unlikely to lead to an upturn in fortunes.
runners.comment: Poor performer on all known form; step up in trip unlikely to lead to an upturn

runners.name: Stabannon
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a pair of better maidens; hard to make a case for here.
runners.comment: Down the field in a pair of better maidens; hard to make a case for here

runners.name: Noble Venture
runners.spotlight: Fared okay after a slow start on debut at Fairyouse over 1m2f; back up to a similar trip here after failing to build on that over 1m at the Curragh.
runners.comment: Fared okay after a slow start on debut at Fairyouse over 1m2f; back up in trip here

runners.name: Shay's Dream
runners.spotlight: No show in three runs in maidens over 7f to 1m; steps up in trip here and hard to ignore completely coming from these quarters; needs a lot more though.
runners.comment: No show in three runs in maidens over 7f to 1m; steps up in trip here; lots more needed

runners.name: Half Cut
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in maidens over further at Fairyhouse and Tramore; needs this for a mark.
runners.comment: Well beaten in maidens over further at Fairyhouse and Tramore; needs this for a mark

races.race_name: Download The Tote App Handicap

runners.name: Connova
runners.spotlight: Overcame plenty of adversity when a strong-finishing third over C&D last month; experience of this track could be invaluable and has a very good draw, if able to get away on terms this time.
runners.comment: Her experience of this track could be invaluable and has a very good draw

runners.name: Nephin Mountain
runners.spotlight: Best run when fourth in a fast-ground handicap at Leopardstown last month over a similar trip; needs to bounce back here, but has the plum draw and certainly respected on that form.
runners.comment: Needs to bounce back here but has the plum draw and respected on Leopardstown form

runners.name: Divine Believer
runners.spotlight: Far from disgraced in a maiden and a handicap on soft ground in the spring; step up to 1m4f proved beyond her in a Leopardstown handicap in May; champion jockey booked and clearly better is expected here, back down in trip.
runners.comment: Champion jockey booked and clearly better is expected here back down in trip

runners.name: Coolshine
runners.spotlight: No show in three maidens and few chances have been taken with his opening mark; looks up against it.
runners.comment: No show in three maidens and few chances have been taken with his opening mark

runners.name: Curious Jane
runners.spotlight: No show in three maidens and never competitive on her handicap debut over 1m1f at Leopardstown, despite not being beaten far; cheekpieces tried this time.
runners.comment: Not being beaten far at Leopardstown last time; cheekpieces tried this time

runners.name: Spring Sprinter
runners.spotlight: Not a huge amount of encouragement from three runs in maidens; likely to do better in this sort of race, but a watching brief looks the prudent option here.
runners.comment: Likely to do better in this sort of race but a watching brief is the prudent option here

runners.name: Aquilla Star
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a heavy ground nursery at Galway last October; failed to cut much ice on her seasonal bow at Down Royal last month; slower ground and probably a longer trip might be more of an optimum for her; best watched.
runners.comment: Slower ground and probably a longer trip might be more of an optimum for her; best watched

runners.name: Music And Song
runners.spotlight: Modest level of ability at a very low level; 5lb wrong here and unlikely to figure.
runners.comment: Modest level of ability at a very low level; 5lb wrong here and unlikely to figure

runners.name: Mare Crisium
runners.spotlight: Showed a little ability in three runs in maidens; beaten out of sight in a Fairyhouse claimer since; others preferred.
runners.comment: Ability in three runs in maidens; beaten out of sight in a Fairyhouse claimer since

races.race_name: Daily Sports Special At Tote.ie Handicap

runners.name: Metamorphic
runners.spotlight: Fair third off 70 in a heavy-ground maiden over this trip at Gowran last October; handicap mark going the right way, but overall form disappointing; the drop back in trip could be a positive.
runners.comment: Mark going the right way but overall form disappointing; drop back in trip maybe positive

runners.name: Real Petite
runners.spotlight: Plenty of ability but has two ways of running; at her best when winning a competitive 1m heat at Gowran in June, much less so off a 7lb higher mark at Leopardstown 17 days later
runners.comment: Two ways of running; at her best when winning a competitive 1m heat at Gowran in June

runners.name: Bucaneer's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Started the season with victory in a 1m handicap at Cork and has kept his form well since without winning; close second over that trip at Bellewstown last time saw him go up another 2lb; new headgear combination tried here and unlikely to be far away; draw is the main negative
runners.comment: New headgear combination tried here and unlikely to be far away

runners.name: Elusive Duke
runners.spotlight: In good form this season without winning; just touched off over this trip at Gowran and a close second over 1m3f at Naas; needs to bounce back after a below-par effort at Killarney last week but every chance that he will; cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Needs to bounce back after a below par effort at Killarney but every chance that he will

runners.name: Lady Chartwell
runners.spotlight: AW winner for Charlie Johnston last year,  but hardly a glimmer of form for her current connections; makes no appeal at present.
runners.comment: Hardly a glimmer of form for her current connections; makes no appeal at present

runners.name: Miss Crinshawn
runners.spotlight: Consistent enough filly; touched off in a heavy ground maiden over 1m2f for John O'Donoghue; seemed to see out longer trips quite well on her last two runs, here and at Tramore; drop back in trip  not certain to suit, but certainly respected.
runners.comment: Consistent enough filly; drop back in trip not certain to suit but definitely respected

runners.name: Nibras Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Six career wins and undergoing a real new lease of life this season with victories in handicaps at Killarney and Leopardstown; 11lb rise for those two wins is not excessive and every chance of going close once more.
runners.comment: Up 11lb for his two wins is not excessive and every chance of going close once more

runners.name: Lady Arwen
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win for almost three years in a 1m Gowran handicap in April; failed to cut much ice in two efforts since; might just prefer it softer these days.
runners.comment: Failed to cut much ice on two latest starts; might just prefer it softer these days

runners.name: Signor Ferrari
runners.spotlight: Decent operator at a level on turf and AW, his most recent win coming in a 1m2f Dundalk handicap in January last year; not seen since third in a Tipperary handicap 14 months ago; market may prove the best guide.
runners.comment: Not seen since third in a Tipperray handicap 14 months ago; market may prove best guide

runners.name: Dancing Steve
runners.spotlight: Good level of form last summer culminated in a deserved success in a 1m2f handicap at Navan; very regressive this season, though, and hard to fancy on current evidence.
runners.comment: Very regressive this season and very hard to fancy on current evidence

runners.name: Brewel Hill
runners.spotlight: Quite lightly raced since winning this race off 68 two years ago; encouraging effort after more than nine months off in a 1m4f handicap at Tramore two weeks ago; foolish to discount.
runners.comment: Won this in 2024; encouraging effort over 1m4f at Tramore layest; foolish to discount

runners.name: Loingseoir
runners.spotlight: Seven career wins and probably not as dependent on soft ground as he once was; consistent this season without really threatening to win and likely to run his race again.
runners.comment: Consistent this season without really threatening to win and likely to run his race again
runners.owner: W Keeling & M C Grassick & Mrs M J Grassick

races.race_name: Tote.ie Everyday Is A Money Back Day Handicap

runners.name: Royal Saxo
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner in France is just 1-10 on turf; has failed to beat a rival in first two runs for this stable; needs to revive upped markedly in trip.
runners.comment: French winner, has failed to beat a rival in two runs for this yard, needs a revival

runners.name: Daboya
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose mare arrives in top form after back-to-back wins over C&D (yielding) and Tramore (1m4f, good) in lower grades; has gone up a total of 13lb but the form of her latest win has since been franked by the runner-up so there could yet be more to come; top rider booked.
runners.comment: Up 13lb for back to back wins inc' over C&D, form of latest win franked, more to come

runners.name: Sea Coral
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner; below par first two runs this term (including when well held behind Londonofficallin in Cork Derby); step in the right direction when 3l third behind Daboya at Tramore latest in first-time tongue tie (retained); mark unchanged and place claims if backing that up.
runners.comment: Back to form behind Daboya at Tramore, mark unchanged, place chance with repeat

runners.name: War Rooms
runners.spotlight: No win since 2023; big chance off this mark on best runs over 1m6f/1m4f last season and though well beaten in both runs this term, they were over an inadequate trip; this distance much more suitable and Colin Keane takes over; interesting.
runners.comment: Big chance off this mark on best form last year, inadequate trip last twice, interesting

runners.name: Steel Cut
runners.spotlight: Promise in maidens and far from disgraced on handicap debut at Navan (1m2f, good) where a 3l fourth of 11 in first-time blinkers (retained); could go well if he stays this longer trip, but pedigree raises questions.
runners.comment: Not disgraced on handicap debut latest, stamina a query upped in trip

runners.name: Duke Of Leggagh
runners.spotlight: Dangerous when gets his favoured soft conditions, as he did when bolting up at Bellewstown in October; however, he's never won off a mark this high, he lacks a run and this ground may be on the lively side.
runners.comment: Dangerous on soft ground, lacks a run, never won off a mark this high, needs rain

runners.name: Londonofficecallin
runners.spotlight: A winner of ten races over hurdles and on the Flat; scored in the Cork Derby (1m4f, soft) on most recent start in this sphere; just 4lb higher now, handles better ground and has run well over hurdles here before; okay run over fences latest and can't discount back on the level.
runners.comment: Up 4lb for Cork Derby win, in okay form over fences since, can't discount back on Flat

runners.name: Deralo Ir
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in a couple of starts for former yard in France; bought for E40,000 at Arqana last July and is likely best watched on stable debut after a 407-day absence, unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Promise in France, off for 407 days, watch on stable debut unless backed

runners.name: Truth Be Told
runners.spotlight: Hold-up sort signed off last season with a 12.5f win at Thurles for Dermot Weld; winning start for this yard at Leopardstown in May over 1m2f; has gone up 14lb for those two wins, but could continue to progress; chance.
runners.comment: Hold up sort, gone up 14lb for wins at Thurles and Leopardstown, could continue progress

runners.name: Pillar Of Hope
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, five of those coming on turf; ground-versatile and showed signs of returning to form when coming from the back for a 6.75l fourth of 15 at Leopardstown on latest; eased 2lb but has not run well on both previous visits to this venue.
runners.comment: Signs of a return to form on latest, eased 2lb, both previous runs here poor

races.race_name: Racing, Sports & Games At Tote.ie Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Tassarolo
runners.spotlight: Back to form with 1.5l third of 15 behind in-form Arch Enemy at Killarney (11.5f, good) five days ago; might prefer a bit of an ease in the ground, but place claims again off the same mark.
runners.comment: Back to form at Killarney latest, same mark now, place chance but might prefer an ease

runners.name: Copper Craft
runners.spotlight: Has placed in three of his five runs this season, including when a 0.75l second to Arch Enemy (who has won again since) on latest at Navan (1m2f, good); also has placed form at 1m4f so decent chance he'll stay this far; place shout at least.
runners.comment: Form of latest second since boosted, decent chance he'll stay this far, place shout

runners.name: Trishuli River
runners.spotlight: Solid strike rate of 4-18 on the AW but 0-11 on turf and has yet to trouble the judge; beaten 22l at Bellewstown 17 days ago; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: 4-18 on AW, 0-11 on turf and failed to trouble judge, beaten 22l on latest, hard to fancy

runners.name: Masego
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m5f (good) Leopardstown handicap off basement mark of 40 on final start for Mags Mullins in May; solid first two runs for this yard; 5l third of 16 at Bellewstown (1m4f, good) and denied by short head at Down Royal (1m5f, good) three days ago; big chance off 2lb lower.
runners.comment: Held form well since L'town win, beaten short head off 2lb lower latest, cheekpieces on

runners.name: Autocrat
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner is 0-19 on turf; hasn't looked like ending that winless run on last three starts, beaten 13l at Navan on latest; others hold stronger claims.
runners.comment: Six-time AW winner, 0-19 on turf, heavy defeats last thrice, others preferred

runners.name: Desert Friend
runners.spotlight: Admirable veteran gained a fourth turf win on the Flat at Sligo in May (1m6f, yld-sft); has come up short off revised mark since but has C&D form figures of 124 and the win came off 6lb higher than he is here; could go well.
runners.comment: Veteran, won at Sligo in May, C&D form figures read 124, capable off this mark, go well

runners.name: Wingit
runners.spotlight: Maiden is 0-5 on turf but her last run at Killarney was encouraging (stayed on well over 1m for a 5l fifth); small yard has been in sensational form and it would be no surprise to see this filly run a big race upped markedly in trip; 1lb wrong but rider's claim negates that.
runners.comment: Stayed on well over 1m latest, yard in sensational form, moves up in trip, can go well

runners.name: Preparations
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeat when last seen on the Flat at Dundalk in January; pulled up over hurdles on return from 168 days latest; remote third over C&D last June off 8lb higher, so can't fully discount but needs to rediscover best.
runners.comment: Pulled up over hurdles latest, has placed over C&D off higher mark, can't fully discount

runners.name: Giselles Defence
runners.spotlight: Four wins in Britain for Ian Williams at 1m2f on all sorts of ground; yet to find form for this stable; new headgear combination tried after 8.5l defeat at Fairyhouse latest.
runners.comment: Four 1m2f wins in Britain, modest form for this yard, new headgear combo needs to spark

runners.name: Reflectionist
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner is 0-10 on the Flat (0-4 on turf); beaten 45l on stable debut after long layoff at Tramore latest; may need another run or two to find form; cheekpieces on.
runners.comment: Beaten 45l on stable debut after layoff at Tramore, cheekpieces tried now

runners.name: Kings Gesture
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a bumper here; minor promise in AW maidens; soundly beaten in first two handicaps at Dundalk and can only be watched after 129-day break.
runners.comment: Minor promise in AW maidens, no impact in first two h'caps, watch after 129 days off

races.race_name: Follow Tote On X Maiden

runners.name: Nuit
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but has run some excellent races in defeat in stakes company; beaten 7.75l in 1m6f (good) Fairyhouse Group 3 on latest; rated 96 and a surprise if she didn't win this.
runners.comment: 0-11 but solid stakes form in book, rated 96, would be a surprise if she didn't win this

runners.name: Black Heather
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner for Harry Kelly; creditable efforts on both Flat starts for this yard; 0.5l third of 8 at Bellewstown in April 2025; 7.25l fourth after layoff at Roscommon latest (1m4f, good); sharper for that and place chance.
runners.comment: Bumper and hurdle winner, strip fitter for respectable Flat run latest, place chance

runners.name: Pampar Lady
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles; okay efforts over fences the last twice and now makes her belated Flat debut; probably best watched.
runners.comment: Three-time winner over hurdles, okay chase efforts last twice, watch on belated Flat debut

runners.name: Catherine Magennis
runners.spotlight: Built on mildly promising debut at Gowran (9.5f, soft) to chase home Ashikita when upped to 1m4f at Roscommon (good); an extra furlong here should pose no problems and she looks the main danger to Nuit; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Good second at Roscommon latest, cheekpieces go on, looks the chief danger to Nuit

runners.name: Figero
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner at Kilbeggan in May; form otherwise poor, including heavy defeats in both bumpers; tailed off on handicap hurdle debut at Tramore on latest; best watched on Flat debut.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner, poor form otherwise, best watched on Flat debut

runners.name: Highlander Addict
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt in bumpers at Wexford on latest (2m1f, good); nicely bred (dam a half-sister to Casamento) and could challenge for place money on Flat debut.
runners.comment: Bumper winner on latest, nice Flat pedigree, place claims on first start on the level

runners.name: Catalani
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point and hunter chase winner; modest Flat debut at Leopardstown over 1m7f; a bit better when a 10.5l fourth over 1m6f at Killarney latest; should get a handicap mark after this.
runners.comment: Point and chase winner, minor promise last time at Killarney, gets h'cap mark after this

runners.name: Way Down South
runners.spotlight: A winner over fences and hurdles; not disgraced on belated Flat debut in a Tramore maiden on latest (1m4f, good), but much more needed to take this.
runners.comment: Chase and hurdles winner, not disgraced on belated Flat debut latest, much more needed

runners.name: Kings Hill
runners.spotlight: Chase and hurdle winner ran well on latest when runner-up in the Connacht National at Roscommon; beaten 12l when fourth on sole Flat start over 1m2f at Leopardstown in July 2024; would prefer softer ground.
runners.comment: Good run in Connacht National latest, fourth on sole previous Flat start, best on soft

races.race_name: A1R Services Ltd Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Arabica Queen
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in her first two runs before battling well to beat the two market leaders in tight finish at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month; should have more to offer now switched to a nursery and she's a key player.
runners.comment: Battled well when winning at Newbury last time and she's respected on nursery debut

runners.name: Regal Tiger
runners.spotlight: Weakened into a remote fourth on Haydock debut (6f, soft) in May but he left that form behind when runner-up to an emphatic winner at Pontefract (6f, good) last month; that form has been boosted by the third since and he needs a close look on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Second behind an emphatic winner at Pontefract and he needs a close look on nursery debut

runners.name: Troublesome Guest
runners.spotlight: Promising third on Newmarket debut (6f, good) in May; ran respectably when in midfield in Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot next time and she had another stiff task in a Group 2 at Newmarket ten days ago; this is more realistic and she needs watching in the market on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Tough task in Listed/Group 2 events in last two starts; market useful on nursery debut

runners.name: Theheatison
runners.spotlight: Faded into fifth in his first two runs but he kept on well for a last-gasp success in a Bath novice (5.6f, firm) 19 days ago; the runner-up's rider had some issues with the reins in the closing stages but this well-bred colt is going the right way and he's respected on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Last-gasp winner at Bath 19 days ago and he neerds a close look in his first nursery

runners.name: Keep Kicking On
runners.spotlight: Modest form in his first two starts but he found plenty of improvement when a close fourth of ten at Doncaster (6f, good to firm; 20-1) 17 days ago; needs to build on that but it's still early days and he's a half-brother to a useful sprinter; in the mix on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Promising fourth in a Doncaster novice last time and he's in the mix on nursery debut

runners.name: El Lambo
runners.spotlight: Comfortable winner at Bath (5.6f, firm) in May but that was a small-field maiden and he struggled in the Woodcote at Epsom (6f, good to soft) last time; now back in calmer waters on quicker ground but he has a mixed record so far and needs to kick on again after a gelding operation.
runners.comment: Has mixed record so far and he needs to kick on again after a gelding operation
runners.owner: The Lamb Inn Wantage Racing Team

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Lady Rosalind
runners.spotlight: Didn't live up to market expectations on Yarmouth debut last month but she left that form a long way behind when beating a clear second at Ripon (6f, good) two weeks ago; has a penalty but she showed a good attitude last time and this well-bred filly is open to more progress; key player.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly who left her debut form well behind when scoring at Ripon; key player

runners.name: Santo
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to three winners including Whenthedealinsdone (5f/6f including 2yo; RPR 102); wasn't beaten far when sixth on Kempton debut in May but she found plenty of progress when a clear third at Newbury (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; didn't get much luck in that race and could be a big factor if she gets the breaks this time.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly who didn't get much luck when third at Newbury; interesting contender

runners.name: Princess Ivy
runners.spotlight: Didn't show much on her Sandown debut but she kept on well when fourth of ten at Newbury (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; that was a promising effort and she could be dangerous if she can build on that.
runners.comment: Promising fourth at Newbury last time and could be dangerous if she can build on that

runners.name: Polyxena
runners.spotlight: 28,000gns breeze-up 2yo; closely related to Italian 6f-7.5f winner Dottor Misagu (including 2yo); dam Italian 7.5f 2yo Listed winner, half-sister to winners Raneenn (6f including 2yo) and King Of Scotia (7f/1m including 2yo); plenty to like on paper but yard is 1-20 with 2yos this season.
runners.comment: Plenty to like on paper but yard is 1-20 with 2yos this season.

runners.name: Soeur De Flash
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; second foal; half-sister to 6f winner Flash Harry (RPR 106); dam sprint maiden (51), half-sister to 5f/6f winners Benny And The Jets and Wiley Post, out of 6f winning sister to Listed-placed 6f winner Poppy Seed; yard 23% with 2yos this season and she's an interesting newcomer; tongue-tie on.
runners.comment: Has a speedy pedigree and yard is 23% with 2yos this season; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Miss Tango
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling by Showcasing; 12-1 on Newbury debut (6f, good to firm) last month and she ran green before finishing a well-held seventh of ten; should know more this time but she needs a major step forward.
runners.comment: Ran green on Newbury debut but she needs a major step forward here

runners.name: All Angels
runners.spotlight: 8,500gns foal, £55,000 yearling; third foal; Harry Angel half-sister to 8.3f winner Sylkie (RPR 77); dam 1m2f winner (79), closely related to 1m4f winner Caledonian Crusade, out of 1m2f winning half-sister to 10.5f Group 3 winner Dance Dress; has speed and stamina in pedigree and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: Has speed and stamina in pedigree and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Pearl Grace
runners.spotlight: Out of Irish 1,000 Guineas/Yorkshire Oaks winner Pleascach; well-held sixth in both runs, but it was a step forward at Epsom (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago and she shaped as though this drop back in trip could suit; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Well held sixth in both runs but it was a step forward last time; not ruled out back at 6f

races.race_name: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Lord d'Or
runners.spotlight: 90,000gns half-brother to a 1m3f winner in Germany; well held in sole 2yo run but he's been knocking on the door in novice events at York (1m, good) and Thirsk (1m, good to firm) this season; sets a clear standard on that form and he's open to more progress at this new trip; strong contender.
runners.comment: Has gone close in both runs this season and he sets a clear standard; strong contender
runners.owner: RC Syndicate X and Gary Gillies

runners.name: Castlemont
runners.spotlight: 375,000gns foal; gelded brother to 1m2f/1m4f winner Bay Bridge (including Group 1; RPR 125), half-brother to winners Stormy Sea (1m; 90) and Nataleena (1m5f-2m; 73); dam sprint maiden (59), half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Shimraan; lots to like on paper and he needs watching in market.
runners.comment: 375,000gns foal; lots to like on paper and he needs watching in market

runners.name: Treble Bass
runners.spotlight: 210,000gns yearling; third foal; gelded half-brother to winners Lava Stream (1m/1m2f including Listed; RPR 107) and Iron Lion (1m2f/1m4f; 103); dam 1m 2yo/1m2f winner (95), half-sister to winners Journey (1m4f Group 1) and Mimikyu (14.5f Group 2); one of two newcomers for Godolphin and interesting to see how he figures in the market.
runners.comment: 210,000gns yearling; one of two newcomers for Godolphin and market should guide

runners.name: Sevenkingsmustdie
runners.spotlight: Struggled in two bumpers and he's been beaten 16l at big prices in both Flat runs (1m2f) this summer.
runners.comment: Struggled in two bumpers and he's been beaten 16l in both Flat runs this summer

runners.name: Cool Girl
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling; second foal; dam twice-raced (runner-up at 1m4f; RPR 76) half-sister to winners Pakistan Star (Hong Kong 1m2f/1m4f Group 1) and Ninas Terz (useful German 6f 2yo); has good standard to aim at on debut but she needs watching in market.
runners.comment: 100,000euros yearling; has good standard to aim at on debut and market should guide

runners.name: Rhythmic Charge
runners.spotlight: 330,000gns foal, 500,000gns yearling; second foal; half-brother to 7f/1m AW winner Breakdancer (RPR 87); dam 5.7f/6f 2yo winner (including Listed; 106), half-sister to useful 1m4f/1m5f Flat and 2m hurdle winner Nessun Dorma; interesting newcomer and he needs a close look.
runners.comment: 500,000gns yearling; interesting newcomer and he needs a close look

runners.name: Flagraiser
runners.spotlight: 125-1 and he finished a tailed-off last on recent Chepstow debut (7f, good to firm).
runners.comment: 125-1 and he finished a tailed-off last on recent Chepstow debut (7f, good to firm)

runners.name: Make A Splash
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at big prices in both runs (1m6f/1m3f) this summer, with RPRs in the 30s on both occasions.
runners.comment: Tailed off in both runs this summer, with RPRs in the 30s on both occasions

runners.name: Sergei Breeze
runners.spotlight: 150-1 and beaten out of sight in a novice at Salisbury (7f, good) last October; gelded since and can only be watched on return for new yard.
runners.comment: 150-1 and beaten out of sight in a novice at Salisbury (7f) last October

races.race_name: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Amazonian Dream
runners.spotlight: His last win was in December 2024 but he's finished runner-up over C&D (good to firm) in his last two starts including behind Lequinto on his penultimate run; didn't get much luck when returned to hold-up tactics last Monday and he looks interesting with Oisin Murphy booked again.
runners.comment: On long losing run but he's finished runner-up over C&D in last two starts; respected

runners.name: Visually
runners.spotlight: Won on Bath debut (5f, good to soft) last October before a second at Wolverhampton 11 days later; well held on handicap debut over C&D last month but he may have needed that run and he's still unexposed; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Unexposed gelding who may have needed his reappearance run here last month; not ruled out

runners.name: Em Four
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins last summer and three AW wins this year, the latest at Wolverhampton in April; ran well when third of five at Salisbury next time but three lesser runs have followed and he needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: Three AW wins this year but he hasn't been at best in last three runs; needs to raise game

runners.name: Buccabay
runners.spotlight: Four-time turf winner including off 5lb higher over C&D (good to firm) last spring; well held at Wolverhampton when last seen in March but that was after a good spell on AW including a Kempton win; has good record when fresh and he needs a close look back from four months off.
runners.comment: C&D winner who is on a workable mark and needs a close look back from a break

runners.name: Lequinto
runners.spotlight: Eight of his 14 wins have come at Windsor and latest was a comfortable success over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; up 5lb but he still looks on a workable mark and has been in good form since April; big player.
runners.comment: Eight-time course winner and latest was over C&D three weeks ago; big player again

runners.name: An Outlaw's Grace
runners.spotlight: Made a successful 2yo debut but he was soon in deep water and his form deteriorated; seen only twice in 2025 but he's been placed a couple of times this season including when third over C&D (good to firm) on his penultimate run; looks interesting on that form and he's not ruled out off a dangerous mark.
runners.comment: On reduced mark and was placed over C&D on his penultimate run; not ruled out

runners.name: Dontspoilasale
runners.spotlight: Won at Dundalk (6f, AW) in January but he's not come close to that form since and was was well held on recent stable debut; now goes back up in trip but he's 1-19 on turf and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Well held on stable debut at Lingfield and he's 1-19 on turf; others preferred

runners.name: Independent Expert
runners.spotlight: Exposed mare who is 6-45 on turf; beaten in claimers on final two runs in Ireland in May and was well held in an Epsom handicap (6f, good; 33-1) on recent stable debut; has something to prove and all of her wins have been over further.
runners.comment: All wins have been over further and she was well held at Epsom (6f) on recent stable debut

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Support The Big Bear Voyage Fillies' Handicap (GBBplus Race)

runners.name: Capichera
runners.spotlight: Generally progressive filly who has form figures of 42321 and she landed the odds with a runaway win in a Pontefract novice (1m, good) three weeks ago; this is tougher off a revised mark back in a handicap but she should have more to offer at this new trip; respected.
runners.comment: Has record of 42321 and that win was by 8l in a novice; respected back in a handicap

runners.name: Dream Camp
runners.spotlight: 250,000euros yearling; made it third-time lucky with an easy win at Southwell (1m, AW) in May and she had a tough task on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (Sandringham) last month; finished in rear in that race but she still has potential and is bred to be suited by this new trip; could resume her progress back in calmer waters.
runners.comment: Tough task on handicap debut at Royal Ascot and she could resume her progress here

runners.name: Mythical Bird
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a clearcut win at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in April but she's lost her way with heavy defeats at Sandown and Newbury in last two runs; has plenty to prove again and overall record is now 1-14.
runners.comment: Won at Lingfield in April but she's lost her way with heavy defeats in last two runs

runners.name: Valkyrie Storm
runners.spotlight: Started this season with two wins at Nottingham (8.3f, good) but she's been well held in her last two starts; didn't get the best of runs at Sandown last time but she needs to find more on this step up to 1m2f.
runners.comment: Started this season with two wins (8.3f) but she's been well held in last two runs

runners.name: Crystal Pier
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when scoring on Wolverhampton reappearance (8.6f, AW) in May; backed that up with a close call at this track (1m, good to firm) but her progress stalled with a disappointing run at Newmarket last time; has bit to prove again after that and she needs to bounce back with tongue-tie added; stablemate of Molo Del Palazzo.
runners.comment: Won at Wolverhampton in May but she flopped at Newmarket last time; tongue-tie now added

runners.name: Sunshine Star
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to connections' Oaks winner Soul Sister; close second to useful rival at Kempton (1m, AW) on sole 2yo start; disappointing on Sandown reappearance in April but she bounced back with an emphatic win at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) last month; looks on fair mark now switched to a handicap and she's open to more progress back on turf; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Emphatic win at Lingfield last month and she's an interesting contender on handicap debut

runners.name: Molo Del Palazzo
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden but she started her handicap career with a creditable second at Lingfield (1m2f, good; 20-1) last month; nudged up 1lb but she kept on well last time and is open to more progress at this trip; in the mix.
runners.comment: Good second on handicap debut at Lingfield (1m2f, good) and she's in the mix

races.race_name: ECA 125th Year Anniversary Handicap

runners.name: Sansanetti
runners.spotlight: Progressive once handicapping over this trip last year, winning four from six (three on Polytrack), latterly off a 2lb lower mark; held in three runs this season but she wasn't beaten far at Lingfield last time and that was more like it; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Showed signs of a revival at Lingfield last time and she's not ruled out

runners.name: Guinness Lad
runners.spotlight: No win in his first 18 starts but he made the breakthrough in a handicap here (11.4f, good to firm) last month and backed that up with a creditable third on his return visit seven days later; now drops back in trip but he ran well over C&D in May and he still looks on a workable mark; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Win and third over 11.4f here in last two runs; dangerous back in trip

runners.name: Saliko
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row at Nottingham (1m2f, good/good to soft) last summer but she's been out of sorts this season and failed to beat a rival at Nottingham last time; now 8lb lower than for her last success but she needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Two wins off higher marks at Nottingham last year but she's been out of sorts this season

runners.name: Danehill Star
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner who is 0-12 on grass but he's been placed on turf in his last three runs including when runner-up at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) 16 days ago; on same mark here and he should be in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: 0-12 on turf but he was runner-up off this mark at Nottingham last time; respected

runners.name: Fast Steps
runners.spotlight: His last win was two years ago but he's been placed in all three runs this season including close calls over C&D (good to firm) and at Ffos Las (1m2f, good); remains well handicapped on his old form and he should make another bold bid.
runners.comment: In-form 8yo who has gone close over C&D and at Ffos Las this season; key player

runners.name: Pay Attention
runners.spotlight: Runner-up off this mark at Newbury (1m, good) in May but slow starts can be an issue and he's been well held in his last two runs; didn't get much luck at Nottingham last time but he's not easy to predict and others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Runner-up off this mark at Newbury in May but he's been well held in both runs since

runners.name: My O My
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent ten-race maiden who was tailed off in a Bath handicap (11.6f, good) last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Inconsistent ten-race maiden who was tailed off in a Bath handicap (11.6f, good) last time

runners.name: Super Hit
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with a brave win at Epsom (1m2f, good) 19 days ago and he backed that up with a creditable third at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm); a 2lb rise has now kicked in but he remains feasibly treated and should go well again.
runners.comment: Brave win at Epsom before a creditable third at Brighton; up 2lb but he's respected

runners.name: Grey Fox
runners.spotlight: Four-time course winner (1m-1m2f) but his last success was over 2m on AW last March; on dangerous mark but he's returned from a lengthy absence with two low-key runs this summer including over C&D; bit to prove and needs to rediscover his spark.
runners.comment: Four-time course winner but he's been quiet since returning from long absence last month

runners.name: Norflondonforever
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark with tongue-tie added at Kempton (1m, AW) in April 2025, but he had a long spell on the sidelines before finishing tailed off in two runs this summer; still has low-mileage but he needs a revival.
runners.comment: Back from 402 days off with two tailed-off efforts this summer; lots to prove

runners.name: Thiscouldbefun
runners.spotlight: Won 1m handicaps at Bath (good to firm) and Lingfield (AW) last year; well treated on that form but she's been generally disappointing since her last success and was beaten 4l when third at Bath last time; needs to raise her game and she's untried at this trip.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but she's hard to predict and is untried at this trip; risks attached
runners.owner: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Gladiadora
runners.spotlight: Turf and dual AW winner who ran near her best when runner-up from wide draw at Kempton (1m, AW; 11-4 favourite) 12 days ago; that was behind an improver who made all and she's a key player off unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Chased home an improver at Kempton last time and he's respected off unchanged mark
runners.owner: Mrs R Coleman And G Glendining

runners.name: Devious Devan
runners.spotlight: Turned things around with a breakthrough win at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in May; disappointing at Ffos Las next time but he bounced back with an eye-catching fifth at Kempton 12 days ago; remains well handicapped on old form and has claims if this sets up for his closing style.
runners.comment: Eye-catcher at Kempton last time and has claims if this sets up for his closing style

runners.name: Footstepinthewoods
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has not finished closer than fifth and was never dangerous at Bath (1m, good) last month; wasn't disgraced behind a major improver last time but he needs to produce a more dynamic effort here.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden and he needs to find some improvement to make an impact

runners.name: Kondratiev Wave
runners.spotlight: Won at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February and runner-up at Southwell (1m, AW) and Bath (1m, firm) in the spring; still looks on a workable mark but his form nosedived at Brighton last time and he needs to bounce back; one of three runners for Tony Carroll.
runners.comment: Has done well this year but he flopped at Brighton last time; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Spirit Of Breeze
runners.spotlight: Added to his two turf wins when finishing well to score on AW at Lingfield (7f) last October; hasn't hit the same level in two subsequent runs but he returned after wind surgery with a fair third in a Class 4 at Salisbury (7f, good) last month; looks worth another try at this trip and he's in the mix on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Returned after wind surgery with a fair third at Salisbury; dangerous back up in trip

runners.name: Flag Carrier
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on hurdle debut when last seen but he's a dual AW winner who is well handicapped on his second at Doncaster (1m, good) last summer; has run well when fresh in the past and he needs watching in market on reappearance; refused to enter stalls in last intended start.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on his best form last summer and he needs watching in market on return

runners.name: River Wharfe
runners.spotlight: 11-time winner, with five on turf and six on AW; his last success was off 2lb higher at Southwell in March but he's struggled since and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: 11-time winner who scored at Southwell in March but he's struggled since

races.race_name: Racing TV EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Kentucky Rain
runners.spotlight: Changed ownership for £380,000 prior to finishing 16th of 27 in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot, running respectably on the figures despite ending up further behind Pershaada than had been the case at Goodwood (5f, good) where she was an eye-catching second amid traffic issues; the form pick.
runners.comment: Eye-catching second at Goodwood then finished 16th of 27 at Royal Ascot; the form pick

runners.name: Concert Pitch
runners.spotlight: Effectively the most exposed contender, having raced five times; placed on three occasions, including twice over C&D; creditable second at Hamilton most recently; reasonably solid but figures in the 60s reflect that he's ordinary.
runners.comment: Placed a few times but is the most exposed contender and an ordinary sort

runners.name: Perryston
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling, 70,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; Havana Grey half-brother to 4.5f-6f winner Fondest Dream (including 2yo/US); dam maiden (RPR 56), sister to 6f Group 3 winner Keystroke; judged on sales information and the stable he represents, looks the pick of the newcomers.
runners.comment: 70,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Havana Grey; looks the pick of the newcomers

runners.name: Unbeatable Fame
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros yearling; by Invincible Army; sibling to winners in Italy (5f/6f, including 2yo) and Poland (1m/1m2f); dam unraced half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Dark Reckoning; check the betting.
runners.comment: 10,000euros yearling; by Invincible Army; check the betting
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Scottys Rocket
runners.spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; by Ten Sovereigns and first foal of unraced half-sister to useful 6f 2yo winner Zumbi and daughter of unraced sister to smart sprinter Land Of Dreams; heed the market signals.
runners.comment: 37,000euros yearling; by Ten Sovereigns; heed the market signals

runners.name: Mubehir
runners.spotlight: 37,000gns yearling, 30,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo by Sioux Nation and first foal of unraced half-sister to Group-placed 7f 2yo winner Sparkling Beauty; yard is 0-34 with 2yos in last five seasons.
runners.comment: 30,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; yard is 0-34 with 2yos in last five seasons

runners.name: Isca Bay
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise over 6f on debut, without quite getting home; fared better over C&D (good to firm; finished second of seven) since and is evidently going to take after her 5f-winning dam; one of the main form players.
runners.comment: Finished second of seven over C&D last time; one of the main form players

runners.name: Dorothea Hope
runners.spotlight: Invincible Army filly; dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Mannaal (1m-11.4f) and Bilhayl (5f), out of 6f 2yo Group 3 winner; probably best watched in this field on debut.
runners.comment: Invincible Army filly; probably best watched in this field on debut

runners.name: Soldier's Echo
runners.spotlight: Has shown signs of ability at Bath (5.7f) and Chester (6f) while looking the type who'll be more interesting in nurseries shortly; chance today partly depends on whether the drop to a bare 5f prompts improvement.
runners.comment: Looks likely to be more interesting in nurseries shortly; drops to 5f

runners.name: Articulate
runners.spotlight: Brings the worst form having finished last of five, achieving little, in 5f contest at Nottingham; looked green but he needs to improve markedly for that run.
runners.comment: Last of five at Nottingham having looked green

runners.name: Black Velvet Boy
runners.spotlight: Absent and gelded since coming home last of the seven finishers at Thirsk in early May; that race has worked out well and he's half-brother to a multiple 5f winner for his yard, so improvement is plausible.
runners.comment: Last of seven finishers at Thirsk but that race has worked out well; gelded since

races.race_name: Happy Birthday Katie Exon Handicap

runners.name: Level Up
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner in previous seasons; 0-11 this year but is proving consistent, close second returned to AW most recently; remains 1lb below last winning mark; in the mix.
runners.comment: 0-11 this year but is proving consistent; 1lb below last winning mark

runners.name: Beerwah
runners.spotlight: Prevailed in small field at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last time, taking record in blinkers to 3-9; back up 4lb but Jack Callan takes off useful 3lb; has won over C&D; enters calculations.
runners.comment: Prevailed at Nottingham last time, taking record in blinkers to 3-9

runners.name: Toptime
runners.spotlight: Retains ability aged eight; made all at Nottingham (5f, soft) last time, building on his reappearance effort and registering an eighth success; has never gained back-to-back wins, though.
runners.comment: Made all at Nottingham last time; has never gained back-to-back wins

runners.name: Great
runners.spotlight: Has gained both wins over 6f, including narrowly at Carlisle (good to firm) last time; back up only 3lb he may remain competitive, provided this drop to 5f proves no issue; opening mark was 13lb higher.
runners.comment: Both wins over 6f, including narrowly latest start; drops to 5f for first time

runners.name: Bibendum
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form at Leicester (5f, good to firm) but beat only two rivals and has gone back up 5lb for that win; returns to a deeper field, albeit has landed the plum draw.
runners.comment: Beat only two rivals at Leicester; now 5lb higher in deeper field

runners.name: Dc Cogent
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame plenty of times since AW maiden win, close third at Thirsk most recently; 0-16 in handicaps but holds a fighting chance off unaltered mark, which is 12lb lower than opening one.
runners.comment: 0-16 in handicaps but has a fighting chance off unaltered mark
runners.owner: J R Dwyer And B Smart

runners.name: Opal Storm
runners.spotlight: Scored on AW in April; inconsistent otherwise of late; has plenty of C&D form, including in this contest, but posted a substandard effort returned to this scenario last time.
runners.comment: Inconsistent of late; substandard effort over C&D last time

runners.name: Dandy Dinmont
runners.spotlight: Far from consistent this season but got up in the final strides over C&D (good to firm; off 1lb higher) in May; possibilities provided he's back in similar form and the race again pans out favourably.
runners.comment: Got up in the final strides over C&D in May; now 1lb lower

runners.name: Dream Deal
runners.spotlight: Struggled in Class 4 event last time; in good form in Class 5 otherwise of late, including C&D success in June; drops back to Class 6 but still needs to prove he can win off marks higher than the 50s.
runners.comment: Drops back in class but isn't favourably treated off current mark

runners.name: Hurt You Never
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner down the years but is 0-7 this term and her form has declined to some degree, as current mark reflects; drops back to Class 6 for the first time in a while.
runners.comment: 0-7 this term and form has declined to some degree

races.race_name: Skybet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap

runners.name: Glenfinnan
runners.spotlight: In-form 6yo whose two attempts over C&D comprise a success in May and 1l second latest start; holds a fighting chance off unaltered mark; defied a stone higher in 2024.
runners.comment: Two attempts over C&D comprise a win in May and 1l second latest start; fighting chance

runners.name: Tattie Bogle
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D in June; below par returned to this scenario last time but that race possibly came too soon after a good effort three days earlier; may rebound.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D in June; possibly best to forgive latest effort; may rebound

runners.name: Coolree
runners.spotlight: Ties in with some of today's rivals on recent C&D form but is still seeking a first success at this trip; has gained all Beverley wins over the extended 1m.
runners.comment: Ties in with some of today's rivals on recent C&D form but has never won at this trip

runners.name: A War Eagle
runners.spotlight: Narrow success in April took his C&D record to 2-3; has remained in form elsewhere since and his latest effort, in Class 2 at Epsom, can be marked up (hampered then rallied for third place); respected back here.
runners.comment: 2-3 over C&D; form of latest effort, in Epsom Class 2, can be marked up; respected

runners.name: It Just Takes Time
runners.spotlight: Back in form with three placed efforts this summer; the latest one took his C&D record to 1113; this front-running 8yo remains just 1lb above last winning mark; solid chance.
runners.comment: Latest effort took his C&D record to 1113; remains just 1lb above last winning mark

races.race_name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Hull Handicap

runners.name: Alice's Influence
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly whose form has rather levelled off; however, may show the benefit of new headgear, having gained her sole success when wearing a first-time visor (retained largely since).
runners.comment: May show the benefit of new headgear; gained her sole win in first-time visor

runners.name: African Spirit
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-10 since debut win but he proved resurgent in first-time tongue-tie and cheekpieces at Windsor (third start for new yard) most recently; may build on that effort; opening mark was 30lb higher; respected.
runners.comment: Proved resurgent in first-time tongue-tie and cheekpieces latest start; respected

runners.name: Walk On Walk On
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; inconsistent this season for new yard but ran well (close second) in 3yo handicap over C&D most recently; possibilities, provided he backs up that effort.
runners.comment: Ran well in 3yo handicap over C&D last time; possibilities if that form is backed up

runners.name: Ice Show
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who isn't particularly solid on form and hasn't made the frame yet; however, this switch to handicap level may enable her to make a bigger impression.
runners.comment: Switch to handicap level may enable her to make a bigger impression

runners.name: Itszaboy
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who is out of a Beverley winner, in cheekpieces, for his connections; not fully convincing on form but is interesting in first-time cheekpieces kept to this course, with improvement possible.
runners.comment: Out of a Beverley winner, in cheekpieces, for his connections; interesting

runners.name: Back From Dubai
runners.spotlight: Retains vitality aged nine, having won at Doncaster in May; below par returned to that venue last time, however, and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Won at Doncaster in May; below par returned to that venue last time

runners.name: King Sharja
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D scorer, including in this race two years ago; the race didn't pan out favourably when returned to this scenario last time (form dipped); 1lb below last winning mark and not ruled out.
runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; the race didn't pan out favourably back here last time

runners.name: Ryefield
runners.spotlight: Far from solid on his sprinting form; chance depends on the effects of new trip and switch to visor (wore cheekpieces last time).
runners.comment: Chance depends on the effects of new trip and switch to visor

runners.name: Bantz
runners.spotlight: Won off higher marks in the first third of 2025 but holds poor claims on his 2026 form for new stable; chance of revival depends on the effects of first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Chance of revival depends on the effects of first-time headgear

races.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans Classified Stakes

runners.name: Royal Sizzler
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who is the only unexposed contender in this field; failed to get home in 1m2f handicap at Beverley most recently, finishing fourth of six; interesting back down in trip, with improvement possible.
runners.comment: The only unexposed contender in this field; non-stayer over 1m2f last time; interesting

runners.name: Inspiring Speeches
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over middle distances for current yard, winning twice (including at Beverley) last summer; recent form includes a creditable effort at this course; major player in this field, provided he copes with drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Suited by Beverley; major player in this field, provided he copes with drop back in trip

runners.name: Copper And Five
runners.spotlight: Veteran whose C&D form features a success in 2025 and a couple of second-place finishes this spring; fighting chance at this level, provided he bounces back (out of the money in last two runs).
runners.comment: Veteran who has C&D form; fighting chance at this level, provided he bounces back
runners.owner: Mrs Sally Doyle And Mrs Ruth Carr

runners.name: Ring Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Five AW wins; form has dipped sharply since returned to turf, taking record in this sphere to 0-24; big revival is required.
runners.comment: Form has dipped sharply since returned to turf; 0-24 in this sphere

runners.name: Elettaria
runners.spotlight: Has plenty of Beverley form, most recently a keeping-on third over 7.5f on penultimate start; however, this three-time Newcastle AW winner is only 1-27 on turf, the win registered in 2023.
runners.comment: Has plenty of Beverley form; however, only 1-27 on turf, the win registered in 2023

runners.name: Defence Missile
runners.spotlight: 4yo maiden who is far from solid on his form for current yard; posted one of his better efforts last time but isn't certain to back it up.
runners.comment: 4yo maiden who is far from solid on his form for current yard

runners.name: Mavetheforcebewivu
runners.spotlight: 4yo maiden who has become far from consistent; creditable second over C&D in June but looks no certainty to reproduce that form.
runners.comment: 4yo maiden; runner-up over C&D in June but isn't sure to reproduce that form

races.race_name: Racing Again Next Tuesday Handicap

runners.name: Shimmering Sands
runners.spotlight: Scored by 7l under a very promising amateur rider last time, completing a Pontefract double (1m2f, good) and taking record this term to 2-2; has won over C&D; surging back up the weights but arrives in great form.
runners.comment: 2-2 this term (Pontefract double); surging back up the weights but is in great form

runners.name: Mwafaq
runners.spotlight: Steadily improving 4yo; prevailed narrowly at Doncaster (good to firm) most recently, making it five wins from his last seven runs (7f/1m) and taking record under Ethan Tindall to 4-5; new trip is the question mark.
runners.comment: Steadily improving and building up a good strike-rate; new trip is the question mark
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Enamorus
runners.spotlight: Placed in four of her six starts; ran well in first-time cheekpieces at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm) most recently, doing best work at the finish; possibilities upped further in distance with the headgear retained.
runners.comment: Did best work at the finish over 8.5f at Beverley with cheekpieces fitted last time

runners.name: Ziata
runners.spotlight: Reasonably consistent five-race maiden for Ed Walker; seemingly outstayed over 1m2f on soft ground last time; sold for 9,500gns since; could go well, assuming she remains in form for new stable.
runners.comment: Reasonably consistent five-race maiden for Ed Walker; sold for 9,500gns since last run

runners.name: Kitsune Power
runners.spotlight: Prevailed by half a length in C&D event (good to firm) last week, ending a long losing sequence and taking Beverley record to 14321; incurs 4lb penalty but remains well treated on lots of form; solid chance.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D last week; incurs 4lb penalty but remains well treated on lots of form

runners.name: Star People
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in two 6f novice runs on good ground in May; gelded since; his experience will be an asset but likely he will need improvement to take this.
runners.comment: Some promise in two 6f runs in May; experience is a plus but likely more is needed to win

runners.name: Great Oak
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam French 7.5f AW winner, closely related to French 9.7f-12.5f winner Spiritueux, half-sister to French 1m/1m2f Group 1 winner Silasol, out of US 1m/8.5f Listed winner; top trainer won this race with a smart newcomer in 2021.
runners.comment: Well-related dam a 7.5f AW winner in France; top yard won this with smart newcomer in 2021

runners.name: Summerstorms Dream
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; she made a promising seasonal reappearance when third of seven over C&D in May but that hasn't been a springboard to better things; Water Of Leith looks the yard's main hope.
runners.comment: 0-9 and not progressing; effective over C&D but stable may have stronger claims elsewhere

runners.name: Whiskey Kisses
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; quiet start for new stable but there was a welcome return to form when third of eight over C&D last week, keeping on and finishing in front of Water Of Leith; 3lb lower today and Danny Tudhope a good booking for the yard (three wins and three seconds from 14 rides); contender.
runners.comment: 0-9 but last week's C&D third was encouraging; positive jockey booking; contender

runners.name: Harlequin Bay
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; promise on AW over the winter but he has suffered two heavy defeats in 6f handicaps (soft and good) this summer; drops in class but there are risks attached.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden; two heavy defeats in turf handicaps this summer; down in class but risky

runners.name: Royal Duke
runners.spotlight: Three 5f wins to his name, one of them at this track, but unplaced in six runs over 6f+; finished behind stablemate Whiskey Kisses over C&D last week; new cheekpieces not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Best form at 5f; finished behind stablemate Whiskey Kisses here last week; new headgear

runners.name: Cotai Starlight
runners.spotlight: Some promise on first two starts (6f; 2yo debut for Ed Walker) but her two 7f runs, including handicap debut (after wind op) three weeks ago, have been less convincing; 4lb lower today but not a solid option.
runners.comment: Well beaten over 7f on last two starts, including handicap debut latest; risky back at 6f

runners.name: Mount Ruapehu
runners.spotlight: Three 6f AW wins for Iain Jardine in the spring; also ran well on turf at Hamilton in May but his form has dipped since; back to his last winning mark but he needs to raise his game; the removal of cheekpieces could be a positive.
runners.comment: Three AW wins in the spring; not so good of late but he's back to his last winning mark

runners.name: Imperial Guard
runners.spotlight: Belatedly ended a long losing run with a smooth defeat of Ramon Di Loria over C&D last week; looks well in under a 5lb penalty and his claims are obvious.
runners.comment: Unextended to beat Ramon Di Loria over C&D last week; well in under a penalty

runners.name: Soul Warrior
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f nursery at Redcar (good to soft) in September; slow start to this campaign but his third at Ripon (6f, good) was a personal best and the step up to 7f could spark further progress; high on the list.
runners.comment: 6f win as a 2yo; good 3rd at Ripon last time and bred to stay this longer trip; contender
runners.owner: D Jenkins J Glover R O'Donnell J Short

runners.name: Ramon Di Loria
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner down the years, adding two AW handicaps to his haul in February; arrives in good form but he was no match for Imperial Guard here last week and the turnaround in the weights may be insufficient.
runners.comment: No match for Imperial Guard when 2nd over C&D last week; better off at weights this time

runners.name: Lanarra
runners.spotlight: Progressive in low-level 6f handicaps, winning at Newcastle in October and placed in both runs this summer; step back up to 7f can help; withdrawn after getting upset in the stalls here last month.
runners.comment: Progressive at a low level; return to 7f no problem; may yet do better

runners.name: Supreme Dancer
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; ran well when second of 11 at Catterick (7f, good) on his seasonal return in May but he failed to back it up at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) five weeks ago; others look stronger.
runners.comment: Failed to build on his promising return when down the field at Wetherby last month

runners.name: Yaaser
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer who is thrown in on his 2025 form; yet to get going this time around but he wasn't beaten far at Carlisle 11 days ago and cheekpieces could give him a lift.
runners.comment: Well handicapped and not beaten far last time; headgear could give him a lift

runners.name: Azure Zain
runners.spotlight: Ran well over C&D last September; beat 17 rivals when landing a Class 4 handicap at Ascot (6f, good to firm) in May but he was unable to build on it at Pontefract last month; perhaps vulnerable once more.
runners.comment: Ascot win was a good effort but not so good at Pontefract last month; others appeal more

runners.name: Veblen Good
runners.spotlight: Made a winning stable debut at Pontefract (6f, good) in April; never featured at Epsom on Oaks day but he was back in form when third of ten at Thirsk 19 days ago; each-way shout.
runners.comment: Two good 6f runs for new yard this season; each-way claims

runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: Ran well over C&D on her penultimate start; 2-1 joint favourite for a 6f fillies' handicap at Carlisle 11 days ago, making some late headway into fourth; should run her race once again.
runners.comment: Solid efforts on last two starts, including C&D; each-way shout again

runners.name: The Caltonian
runners.spotlight: Useful on AW on his day but 0-21 on turf; handicapped accordingly but his latest C&D 12th didn't suggest he was the answer to today's puzzle.
runners.comment: Much better on AW: handicapped accordingly but latest C&D 12th needs leaving behind
runners.owner: John Murphy & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Oriental Prince
runners.spotlight: Another who has a better strike-rate on AW than turf; not beaten far into fourth in a 5f handicap at Doncaster 17 days ago, a race where he fluffed the start; yet to shine at Ayr; one of three runners for Jim Goldie.
runners.comment: Better strike-rate on AW but yet to shine at Ayr and others are more appealing; yard run 3

runners.name: Clonmacash
runners.spotlight: The bulk of his winning has been done on AW but he did win a 5f handicap at the Curragh last August; recent efforts need bettering but he would seem likely to give his running.
runners.comment: Better strike-rate on AW but running well enough on turf in Ireland this year; needs more

runners.name: Lord Roxby
runners.spotlight: Running well in 6f handicaps this summer, beating a big field at York in May and running to a similar level in defeat twice since; no obvious reason why he wouldn't go well again.
runners.comment: In good form in 6f handicaps this summer; likely to be in the thick of it again
runners.owner: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover

runners.name: Gentle George
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three handicaps for new stable this year, the latest over a mile nine days ago; latest 5lb drop in the weights is not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Yet to shine for new yard; opposable despite drop in trip/weights

runners.name: Jordan Electrics
runners.spotlight: Not won since his stellar campaign in 2024 but there has been promise this year, including at Hamilton on Friday; 2lb lower today and now sports cheekpieces for the first time; chance.
runners.comment: On a losing run but on a dangerous mark and new headgear could help; one to consider
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

runners.name: Mayor Of Maghera
runners.spotlight: Two solid runs to begin his time with this yard and the addition of cheekpieces saw him win a 1m1f handicap at Musselburgh three weeks ago; only 2lb higher and he should give it another good go.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces added last time and they had the desired effect, winning over 1m1f; chance

runners.name: Keep Me Stable
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row over 1m and 7f at Musselburgh (all on good) last June and July but she wasn't seen after August and two runs this year have been poor; risky.
runners.comment: Not come close to 2025 best in two runs this year; risky for now

runners.name: Hale End
runners.spotlight: In good form in the spring, winning at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) before near misses at Thirsk and over C&D; not at his best on his last two starts but this is an ease in class and he's a major player in his bid to win this race for a second time (successful in 2024).
runners.comment: 2024 winner of this race; struggled in higher grade on last 2 runs; big player in Class 5

runners.name: Starliner
runners.spotlight: Beat Donna Nook over C&D in May when rated 1lb higher; put a couple of lesser efforts behind him when chasing home Runninsonofagun here last week; 7lb better off for 2l defeat so has a handicapping chance; new visor replaces cheekpieces; others still more appealing.
runners.comment: Has a win and a second over C&D to his name this year; change of headgear; weights chance
runners.owner: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Donna Nook
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run when beating 11 rivals at Ripon (1m, good) last month; respectable efforts since without suggesting she was ahead of her mark.
runners.comment: Ripon win last month has been followed by two lesser efforts; others look better treated

runners.name: Krissy
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 on the up and she has maintained her progress in 2026, winning four times over 1m1f on good ground; not at her best last time but foolish to think she won't continue progressing; unraced on faster than good.
runners.comment: Progressive mare; not at best last time and this will be the fastest ground she's faced

runners.name: Cisco Disco
runners.spotlight: Won four handicaps here (1m-1m2f, good or slower) in the second half of 2025; yet to fire this time around and may need both slower ground and further help from the handicapper.
runners.comment: Four course wins (1m-1m2f) in second half of 2025; yet to shine this year; ground query

runners.name: Benacre
runners.spotlight: No turf win since 2022 but he has won three AW handicaps in the last 14 months; should be well treated but recent efforts haven't been his best; this is a drop in class so not dismissed, even though the return of cheekpieces wouldn't be an obvious plus based on previous usage.
runners.comment: No turf win since 2022 but well treated and this is a drop in class; cheekpieces return

runners.name: Runninsonofagun
runners.spotlight: Gained first win since his 2yo days when making all in a Class 6 over C&D last week (blinkered first time); unlikely to get a soft lead this time and a 5lb penalty against stronger opposition demands more in any case.
runners.comment: Blinkers helped when making all in Class 6 over C&D last week; this tougher under penalty

runners.name: Taylormade Lad
runners.spotlight: Back to the mark off which he won at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) last August; finished third in his first two runs this year but not at the same level on his last two starts; drops in trip/grade and could bounce back to form.
runners.comment: On a winning mark; started the year with promise but lesser runs on last two starts

runners.name: Phantom Shadow
runners.spotlight: Second of nine at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) 18 days ago, after which he was sold out of Harry Charlton's stable for 18,000gns; should have more to offer over this trip; interesting.
runners.comment: Ran his best race for former yard when upped to 1m2f 18 days ago; more to come from him
runners.owner: J D Wright & Mrs S Wright

runners.name: Glasses Up
runners.spotlight: Veteran who was recording his 12th win at the track when leading close home over 1m5f last week; able to race off a 3lb lower mark today and he has to be of interest from a handicapping perspective.
runners.comment: 12th course win when narrowly landing 1m5f handicap last week; races off 3lb lower today

runners.name: Falcon Nine
runners.spotlight: Ran well at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last month; not so good in either run since, the latest over C&D two weeks ago; not ruled out but not the most solid option either.
runners.comment: Chance on his Pontefract second last month but not so good in either start since

runners.name: Wadacre Geisha
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two of her four handicaps; her form dipped at Nottingham 18 days ago but no surprise to see her bounce back with a big run.
runners.comment: Runner-up in two of her four handicap runs; can bounce back from latest quiet effort

runners.name: On The Bubble
runners.spotlight: Ran well from out of the handicap at Catterick (1m4f, good to firm) last week, poaching a big lead but reeled in close home; whether she can repeat that form in this bigger field remains to be seen.
runners.comment: Good run from out of the weights at Catterick last week; no banker to be in the same form

runners.name: Motawaared
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; only one effort of note since joining Jim Goldie but he drops into his first 0-60 having undergone wind surgery since last seen; interesting to see how strong he is in the market.
runners.comment: Drops in grade and has undergone wind surgery since latest start; betting instructive

runners.name: Toy Soldier
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f when trained by George Scott; initially struggled in Ireland but finished second in a couple of handicaps at around 7f last month; beaten favourite over 7f here two week ago, after which he left Maurice Ahern; stamina for 1m2f has to be taken on trust and he goes without headgear on his stable debut.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice at around 7f in Ireland last month; trip query on stable debut

runners.name: Sophiesticate
runners.spotlight: Third in 1m4f handicaps at Musselburgh on her last two starts, staying on nicely on both occasions; drop back in trip on faster ground isn't sure to suit.
runners.comment: Kept on for 3rd in 1m4f handicaps on last two starts; drop in trip not sure to benefit her

runners.name: Golden Valour
runners.spotlight: Veteran with plenty of course form to his name; third of nine over 1m here last week (winner Runninsonofagun runs in the 4.00); one of three runners for the stable.
runners.comment: Veteran who was a solid third over 1m here last week; stable run three here

runners.name: Sands Of Seve
runners.spotlight: Improved for the addition of a visor when easily seeing off six rivals in a 5f handicap at Wolverhampton in March; well beaten on next three starts and sold out of Robert Cowell's stable for 2,200gns in May; fine effort when short-headed on his stable debut at Musselburgh three weeks ago and a repeat would see him go well despite a 2lb rise.
runners.comment: AW winner for Robert Cowell; fine effort on stable debut last month; major player up 2lb

runners.name: Sea Her Excel
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a 5.5f handicap at Wetherby last month; unable to build on it at Windsor 11 days later but she still has low mileage.
runners.comment: Made all over 5.5f at Wetherby in June; failed to build on it last time; still unexposed

runners.name: Brain Freeze
runners.spotlight: Won at Redcar (5f, good to firm) in May off a 2lb lower mark and she followed it with a good third at Ripon; played up beforehand and then in the stalls when disappointing at Beverley four weeks ago; needs to show that temperamental display was a one off.
runners.comment: Temperamental effort latest but she had been on the up beforehand

runners.name: Golden Havana
runners.spotlight: 5f AW win in December; knocking at the door this year, including when a close second on his return to turf at Thirsk (5f, good) last month; now 2lb higher but likely to give his running.
runners.comment: Knocking at the door this year, including back on turf last month; 2lb higher today

runners.name: Brash
runners.spotlight: Steady progress in three novice/maiden runs and he took another step forward when second of nine on his handicap debut at Ripon (6f, good) two weeks ago (finished just in front of Soul Warrior who runs in the 3.00); open to further improvement and looks quick enough for 5f.
runners.comment: Improved his RPR with each run, finishing second on recent handicap debut; more to come

runners.name: Under The Radar
runners.spotlight: Having dropped in the weights he ran his best race of the year when third of nine at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) on Thursday; now has something to build on.
runners.comment: Returned to form when third of nine at Thirsk last week; now has something to build on

runners.name: Gambino
