runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who has shown some useful form on the Flat and was placed in a good-quality Newbury novice (2m, good to soft) on hurdle debut in March, having travelled strongly for a long way; had wind op in May; needs to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: Travelled strongly when placed in good-quality Newbury novice on hurdle debut in March

runners.name: Speed For Fun
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat in France last year and had Listowel maiden hurdle (2m4f, good to yielding) at his mercy before last-flight fall on stable debut in May; first runner at this track for top Irish trainer Willie Mullins; obvious contender.
runners.comment: Flat winner in France; had Listowel maiden at his mercy before last-flight fall in May

runners.name: Kind Of Kiss
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat, albeit yet to add to French maiden win in spring 2024 and not at best for new stable this year; has good standard to reach on hurdling debut but could have a future over jumps; had wind op in April.
runners.comment: Useful on the Flat; has good standard to reach on hurdle debut but worth keeping an eye on

runners.name: Masekela
runners.spotlight: Formerly smart on the Flat (fourth in 2022 Derby) but was knocking about in low-grade handicaps last year; well beaten on stable/hurdle debut in May but shaped with much more promise when third over C&D (albeit well held in the end) later that month, and might collect another minor prize today.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise when third (albeit well held in the end) over C&D in May; place claims

runners.name: Order Another One
runners.spotlight: Won Irish maiden point in May but hasn't shown much on her two hurdling starts here (2m1f/2m6f) this summer, the latter on Saturday.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown much on her two hurdling starts here (2m1f/2m6f) this summer

runners.name: Scopic
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a bumper and on both hurdling starts.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a bumper and on both hurdling starts

runners.name: Steps In Time
runners.spotlight: Has shown some fair Flat form but became disappointing for David O'Meara last year and was soundly beaten in two 2m novice hurdles for new stable this spring.
runners.comment: Became disappointing on the Flat and was soundly beaten on first two hurdling starts

runners.name: Destination Unkown
runners.spotlight: Lowly rated Flat maiden who was pulled up when a big-priced outsider for both hurdle runs last season.
runners.comment: Pulled up when a big-priced outsider for both hurdle runs last season

runners.name: Seeyainthesuninn
runners.spotlight: Came good at ninth attempt, drawing 13l clear to score over C&D (good) last month; hiked up 10lb for that and too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but still an obvious one to consider.
runners.comment: Came good with 13l C&D win last month, his ninth start; went up 10lb for that

runners.name: Time Was
runners.spotlight: Consistent in defeat last autumn and winter (2m3f-2m4f) but well below best since returning from three-month break this spring (three runs), and was pulled up over C&D on only previous visit here.
runners.comment: Consistent in defeat last autumn/winter but well below best since returning from break

runners.name: Secret Secret
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner, including last two editions of this race; would appeal sightly more on ground slower than good but his fourth here (3m1f, good) two starts ago was a good effort and his well-held fifth over C&D last month came in a much stronger race than this; high on the list.
runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; ran well here two starts ago and this is easier than latest task

runners.name: Dusky Days
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m1f (good) here last summer and was second here on next two outings (2m6f/3m1f); not at same level this year (four runs) and was tailed off last time (2m1f) but can't be ruled out off current mark.
runners.comment: Has mixed record this year but is well handicapped on last summer's course form

runners.name: Born Like Me
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all six hurdle starts; not disgraced when fourth of seven over about 2m6f (if additional yardage is included) at Market Rasen (good) last month, though, and may yet have a bigger run in him.
runners.comment: 0-6 over hurdles; not disgraced last time, though, and may yet have a bigger run in him

runners.name: Cross Of Redmoor
runners.spotlight: 0-9 in points and 0-7 under rules; tailed off on last month's chasing debut (1m7f), after a break, and now reverts to hurdling in new headgear; 9lb out of the weights; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: 0-16 under all codes; reverts to hurdling in new headgear; 9lb out of the weights

runners.name: Westerton
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat; back over hurdles for new stable this season, with by far the best of three runs a close second at Warwick (2m, good) two starts ago; pulled up over 2m1f since and not easy to predict over this new trip.
runners.comment: Close second over 2m in May but pulled up since; hard to predict over this new trip

runners.name: Present Fair
runners.spotlight: Free-goer who won twice at Bangor last year (2m3f/2m7f); absent since consecutive heavy defeats last July/September, though, and returns with quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Won twice last year (2m3f/2m7f) but off since consecutive heavy defeats in July/September

runners.name: Drumlee Myth
runners.spotlight: Placed in all three bumpers last year in 2024; did not show a great deal over hurdles last year but had soft ground as a plausible excuse when tailed off here (2m1f) on handicap debut a year ago; tries a new trip on this first start since; worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: Off since well beaten here (2m1f) on handicap debut a year ago; still worth market check

runners.name: Fairlawn Skipper
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; made quite promising start to hurdling career last autumn but looked out of sorts in two handicaps this spring (3m2f/2m7f) and it takes a leap of faith to support him here.
runners.comment: Looked quite promising in the autumn but well beaten in two handicaps this spring

runners.name: Lelantos
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner, most recently off today's mark at Huntingdon (3m1f, good to soft) in November; has become inconsistent, though, and dropped out quite tamely after making the running at Fontwell in May.
runners.comment: Won off this mark in November but become inconsistent & not easy to predict the good days

runners.name: Zuul
runners.spotlight: Returned from seven-month break with creditable third over C&D (good) in May and has obvious each-way claims if judged on that effort but Market Rasen last month was a backward step and he's now 0-14 over hurdles.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D in May but not in same form last month and now 0-14 over hurdles

runners.name: Katzoff
runners.spotlight: 0-47 under all codes, having spent the bulk of his career in Ireland; flopped badly when favourite for recent stable debut at Stratford (2m2f, good to firm) but tries a new trip and sports first-time blinkers here; no surprise if Dan Skelton finds the key to him soon.
runners.comment: Pulled up on stable debut and now 0-47 but may still come good for Dan Skelton

runners.name: Les's Destiny Star
runners.spotlight: Seemed to have been aided by a wind op when placed at Ffos Las (3m, good to soft) in April, his second handicap, but was pulled up on next two outings (latter was chase debut) and has since left Ben Pauling; has tongue-tie refitted for stable debut; cheekpieces removed after one use.
runners.comment: Placed for Ben Pauling in April but pulled up twice since; now with new stable

runners.name: Masterminding
runners.spotlight: Beaten over 19l when third over C&D last month and now 0-8 over hurdles but ran big race when second over C&D (good) on stable debut in May and has strong claims if judged on that performance.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D on both stable starts (albeit well held last time); must be considered

runners.name: Matoury
runners.spotlight: In-form 7yo who comes here after two narrow wins at Market Rasen (both 3m+, good); latest 4lb rise ought to be manageable and this drop back in trip won't be a problem; big player if suited by this different track.
runners.comment: In-form 7yo who comes here after two narrow wins at Market Rasen

runners.name: Fourofakind
runners.spotlight: Regressive 7yo who had a disappointing campaign last season; returns from four-month break on a dangerous mark but was soundly beaten on both previous starts here and has quite a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Back from break on dangerous mark but disappointing campaign last season
runners.owner: Mrs G Jenkinson And Mrs B Butterworth

runners.name: Top Flight Century
runners.spotlight: 2-17 over hurdles; not yet proven over quite this far but posted good effort when third at Perth (2m4f, good) this month and didn't run badly over 2m1f on only previous visit to Cartmel; could have a say.
runners.comment: Placed at Perth (2m4f) this month and ran okay on only previous visit here

runners.name: Raffles Nobu
runners.spotlight: Took a while to get off the mark for current stable and had become expensive to follow but exploited much-reduced mark when winning stylishly at Newton Abbot (2m2f, good to firm) a week ago and still looks well treated under a 7lb penalty.
runners.comment: Won stylishly at Newton Abbot last week and still looks well treated under a penalty

runners.name: Scots Poet
runners.spotlight: Resurgent 10yo who led close home at Perth (2m, good) last month and has now won three times since April; unlucky to come to grief when back at Perth last week and remains of strong interest, albeit he was well beaten over C&D on his only previous start here.
runners.comment: Resurgent 10yo who has won three times since April; shortlisted

runners.name: Mr Globalist
runners.spotlight: Swapped usual cheekpieces for refitted visor and gave good account when third from 3lb out of the weights over C&D (good) on Saturday; will effectively be 1lb lower if he turns out again but his 0-42 career strike-rate is not easily overlooked.
runners.comment: Ran well when third here on Saturday but 0-42 career strike-rate not easily overlooked

runners.name: Zamond
runners.spotlight: Four hurdle wins, including this race in 2022; well held in C&D selling handicap in May, after a break, but last month's keeping-on second here was much better and he remains on a workable mark.
runners.comment: Well held here in May, after a break, but last month's keeping-on second was much better

runners.name: Ambassador
runners.spotlight: Now 9lb lower than when making all over C&D (good) last August but his form has slumped since and a revival is needed.
runners.comment: Now 9lb lower than when making all over C&D last August but his form has slumped since

runners.name: Interchangeable
runners.spotlight: Ran well for a long way when third at Kelso (2m2f, good) in April but two lesser efforts have followed and he's now 0-7 for current stable; sometimes races too freely; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Ran well when placed at Kelso in April but two lesser efforts followed; others preferred

runners.name: Big Gypsy King
runners.spotlight: Improved to cause 25-1 surprise in C&D (good) novice last month, her fourth start over hurdles, but the value of that form is open to question (market principals disappointed) and her opening handicap mark probably demands further progress.
runners.comment: Surprise C&D novice winner last month but the form looks dubious; more needed today

runners.name: Assorda
runners.spotlight: Out of form for new stable this year and needs recent wind op to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Out of form for new stable this year and needs recent wind op to have made big difference

runners.name: Slaney Opera
runners.spotlight: Former pointer/hunter chaser who won a Sedgefield handicap (3m2f, good to soft) off 2lb higher for Ruth Jefferson in January; not quite in same form on first four starts for new stable and fell on latest outing a week ago but it's difficult to put a line through him.
runners.comment: Not quite at best for current stable but won for another yard off 2lb higher in January

runners.name: Stratagem
runners.spotlight: Very useful in his prime and enjoying a revival this year, with the latter of two wins gained here (3m5f, good) in May; last month's C&D third was perfectly respectable and he ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Won over 3m5f here in May and last month's C&D third was also a good run; big player

runners.name: Le Malin
runners.spotlight: Left clear at final fence to exploit reduced mark at Down Royal (2m4f, good to yielding) on Boxing Day 2024 and will be fine over this longer trip but this is his first run since and he's a 12yo now.
runners.comment: Absent since 2m4f win on Boxing Day 2024 and now a 12yo

runners.name: Krak
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Twiston-Davies stable with creditable second behind a next-time-out winner over hurdles in May, having made the running in first-time cheekpieces; last throughout on stable debut without headgear in four-runner Newton Abbot chase this month but the cheekpieces are back on here and it will be interesting to see whether connections revert to more positive tactics.
runners.comment: Made low-key stable debut in a chase but signed off for old yard with good hurdle run

runners.name: Kientzheim
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when weakening fifth on last month's chasing debut at Hexham but now 2lb lower than when close third over hurdles here in May and will be dangerous if able to transfer that form to fences.
runners.comment: Shade disappointing on recent chase debut but close third over hurdles here two runs ago

runners.name: Dunkerque
runners.spotlight: Won novice hurdle in April and is 3-3 over fences since, the latest win gained in three-runner contest at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good) last month; may still have more improvement to come if aided by first-time cheekpieces but contests a stronger race here and the drop back in trip is not sure to suit.
runners.comment: 3-3 over fences; may have more to offer but this drop back in trip is not sure to suit

runners.name: Passing Diamond
runners.spotlight: Delivered on promise shown in Irish points/bumpers when making all twice over hurdles in novice company at Hexham (2m/2m4f, good) in May; respectable third on handicap debut there (2m4f, good) last month and looks quite interesting on this chase debut, even from 4lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner at Hexham this spring; 4lb wrong on chasing debut but still considered

runners.name: El Muchacho
runners.spotlight: Placed three consecutive times in March-May (2m4f-2m5f, good/good to soft) and has claims if judged on that form but didn't fire when well-held third of four on latest outing and also disappointed on only previous visit to Cartmel; usually ridden patiently; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Claims if judged on this spring's placed form but needs to prove himself at this track
runners.owner: T J Stubbins and M E Sowersby

runners.name: Imperial Rule
runners.spotlight: Led close home to cause 25-1 surprise over C&D (good) in May, form that has been very well advertised by the placed horses (one was Kingofthegame) since; not in same form over hurdles last month but still strongly considered; wears first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Safely held over hurdles last month but form of C&D win in May has worked out well

runners.name: Aill Dubh
runners.spotlight: One of two to pull clear of the others when opening account at Newcastle (2m7f, good to soft) in March, and both subsequent fourths (3m/3m1f; latter was here) were perfectly respectable; may benefit from this drop back in trip; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Newcastle winner in March; both runs since respectable; this drop back in trip can suit

runners.name: Jack Sprat
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key stable debut (over hurdles) when second to very progressive rival over C&D (good) last month and remains well handicapped on some of his form for Jamie Snowden; likely contender.
runners.comment: Second to very progressive rival over C&D last month and remains on a good mark

runners.name: Judicial Review
runners.spotlight: Gained all three chase wins at this track (2m5f-3m1f); bounced back from two lacklustre efforts when staying on to go close here (3m1f, good; usual tongue-tie/blinkers left off) on Saturday and remains well handicapped but it's hard to predict whether he'll be in the right mood again; wears cheekpieces for first time since 2024.
runners.comment: Returned to form and went close here (3m1f) on Saturday but has become hard to predict

runners.name: Wearelongterm
runners.spotlight: Placed in two 2m7f Kelso chases in the autumn (good/good to soft) but ran poorly over 3m1f here on Saturday, after a five-month break, and will need to rebound quickly.
runners.comment: Placed twice at Kelso in the autumn but ran poorly here on Saturday; needs quick rebound
runners.owner: Dennis J Coppola & Mrs Dianne Sayer

runners.name: Path Of Stars
runners.spotlight: 1-16 over hurdles, having gained a hard-fought course win (2m6f, good) in May; evidently well suited by this track but will need to find hidden reserves to overcome a 4lb higher mark on this chasing debut.
runners.comment: Gained hard-fought course win over hurdles in May; bit more needed on this chasing debut

runners.name: Fast Deal
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on both starts this year (3m1f/2m3f) and makes no appeal from 10lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Well beaten on both starts this year and makes no appeal from 10lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Blazing Court
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form but failed to complete three consecutive races in April-June and was well beaten here (2m1f) on Saturday; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Failed to complete three consecutive races in April-June and well beaten here on Saturday
